title: JWT is signed with a guessable secret
summary: The HS256 signing secret is a common weak value, so a token can be re-signed for any account.  This is a full authentication bypass.

confirm.control: The signed out view of the same endpoint, which must differ from the signed in one.
confirm.differential: status==200 and same(response, authed) and differ(response, anon)

reproduce: Re-sign the session JWT (claims unchanged) with a common secret such as 'secret' using HS256, and request an authenticated endpoint with it.  A signed in response means the secret is that weak value.
remediate: Use a long random signing secret from a secret manager, and rotate it.
